title: Reprogramming tumor-associated macrophages through TLR4 N-glycosylation: A GnT-V mRNA delivery strategy to improve PD-1 inhibitor responsiveness.
snippet: PD-1 inhibitors have revolutionized cancer treatment, but their antitumor efficacy is limited by various constraints, including the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) driven by tumor-promoting tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs).
